description: Triage for storm damage and roof leaks. Gives an urgency of routine, soon or emergency (the same three speeds as Nero Work) with the reasons, safe first steps for the homeowner (no climbing, electrics, bulging ceilings, gas, falling debris, insurer), the temporary cover the roofer should use for each problem (tarpaulin battened over the ridge, tile clips, tingles, flashing tape, cold patch), what to photograph, and a Nero Work job title. Typical call: {"symptoms":["water_coming_through_ceiling","tiles_or_slates_missing"],"missing_count":12,"more_bad_weather_within_24h":true}.

missing_count.description: Roughly how many tiles or slates are missing.

trade.description: Optional. The roofer's own business details (Nero Trade Profile v1). Used to put the contractor on risk notes and to give a stable nero_trade_ref. Not stored by Ridge Pack.

company_name.description: Registered company name, if a limited company.

company_number.description: Companies House number, for example 12345678 or SC123456.

display_name.description: Trading name shown to customers, for example "Hilltop Roofing".

licence_body.description: Competent person scheme or trade body the business is registered with (CompetentRoofer is the roofing scheme run by the NFRC).

vulnerable_people_in_home.description: Elderly, disabled, very young or unwell people living there.

name: storm_triage
title: Storm damage and leak triage
